name: page3-text-013
text: UNITED STATES PATENT OFFICE.

name: page3-text-014
text: HERBERT W. ALDEN, OF THE UNITED STATES ARMY, ASSIGNOR TO NEWTON D.

name: page3-text-015
text: BAKER, SECRETARY OF WAR OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, TRUS-

name: page3-text-016
text: TEE.

name: page3-text-017
text: TANK.

name: page3-text-019
text: Specification of Letters Patent.

name: page3-text-020
text: Patented Jan. 25, 1921.

name: page3-text-021
text: Application filed December 14, 1918.  Serial No. 266,817.

name: page3-text-022
text: (FILED UNDER THE ACT OF MARCH 3, 1883, 22 STAT. L., 625.)

name: p3_L_line001
text: To all whom it may concern:

name: p3_L_line002
text: Be it known that I, HERBERT W. ALDEN,

name: p3_L_line003
text: lieutenant colonel, Ordnance Dept., United

name: p3_L_line004
text: States Army, a citizen of the United States,

name: p3_L_line005
text: stationed at Washington, District of Co-

name: p3_L_line006
text: lumbia, have invented an Improvement in

name: p3_L_line007
text: Tanks, of which the following is a specifi-

name: p3_L_line008
text: cation.

name: p3_L_line009
text: The invention described herein may be

name: p3_L_line010
text: used by the Government, or any of its offi-

name: p3_L_line011
text: cers or employees in prosecution of work for

name: p3_L_line012
text: the Government, or by any other person in

name: p3_L_line013
text: the United States, without payment of any

name: p3_L_line014
text: royalty thereon.

name: p3_L_line015
text: As military “tanks,” so called, have hereto-

name: p3_L_line016
text: fore been constructed, so far as I am aware,

name: p3_L_line017
text: the sponson has been an immovable and ir-

name: p3_L_line018
text: removable structure, which projects from

name: p3_L_line019
text: the side of the tank. In many instances, the

name: p3_L_line020
text: sponson forms an obstruction to the passage

name: p3_L_line021
text: of the tank, because (assuming a hypotheti-

name: p3_L_line022
text: cal case) it may be desired to drive the tank

name: p3_L_line023
text: through a narrow ravine (artificial or natu-

name: p3_L_line024
text: ral) which is of insufficient width to permit

name: p3_L_line025
text: the passage of the tank with such projecting

name: p3_L_line026
text: sponson, but which is of a width which would

name: p3_L_line027
text: permit the passage of a tank if such spon-

name: p3_L_line028
text: son were not present.

name: p3_L_line029
text: The principal object of my invention is,

name: p3_L_line030
text: therefore, to provide a tank with a movable,

name: p3_L_line031
text: projecting sponson, whereby a tank equipped

name: p3_L_line032
text: with my invention may travel where tanks

name: p3_L_line033
text: of proportionate size, but which are pro-

name: p3_L_line034
text: vided with immovable sponsons, cannot go,

name: p3_L_line035
text: and thus accomplish results which it is im-

name: p3_L_line036
text: possible to attain with such other tanks.

name: p3_L_line037
text: With these objects in view, and others

name: p3_L_line038
text: appearing as the specification proceeds and

name: p3_L_line039
text: the nature of the invention is more fully dis-

name: p3_L_line040
text: closed, the invention resides, broadly and

name: p3_L_line041
text: generally stated, in a tank provided with a

name: p3_L_line042
text: movable sponson and, more specifically, in a

name: p3_L_line043
text: tank provided with a sponson adapted to

name: p3_L_line044
text: swing on a pivot from a position normally

name: p3_L_line045
text: outside the tank to a position therewithin,

name: p3_L_line046
text: to meet the exigencies of a particular situa-

name: p3_L_line047
text: tion.

name: p3_L_line048
text: The invention also resides in various struc-

name: p3_L_line049
text: tural refinements, tributary to the basic con-

name: p3_L_line050
text: struction just referred to, which go to make

name: p3_L_line051
text: up the ultimate perfection of the gun as an

name: p3_L_line052
text: entirety.

name: p3_L_line053
text: The accompanying drawings disclose an

name: p3_L_line054
text: exemplary concrete embodiment of the un-

name: p3_R_line055
text: derlying principles of my invention. Like

name: p3_R_line056
text: reference characters identify corresponding

name: p3_R_line057
text: parts throughout the several views, which

name: p3_R_line058
text: latter may be briefly described as follows:

name: p3_R_line059
text: Figure 1 is a fragmentary longitudinal

name: p3_R_line060
text: vertical sectional view of a tank equipped

name: p3_R_line061
text: with a sponson constructed in accordance

name: p3_R_line062
text: with my invention;

name: p3_R_line063
text: Fig. 2 is a cross sectional view on the line

name: p3_R_line064
text: 2—2, Fig. 1; and

name: p3_R_line065
text: Fig. 3 is a horizontal sectional view

name: p3_R_line066
text: through the sponson.

name: p3_R_line067
text: Referring, now, in detail to the drawings:

name: p3_R_line068
text: The sponson 1 is, in contra-distinction to

name: p3_R_line069
text: the ordinary construction of sponsons, a

name: p3_R_line070
text: movable body and, for this purpose, is ap-

name: p3_R_line071
text: propriately supported upon hinges 2—2 car-

name: p3_R_line072
text: ried by the tank frame 3, whereby the spon-

name: p3_R_line073
text: son may swing in a horizontal plane from

name: p3_R_line074
text: the normal full-line position thereof to the

name: p3_R_line075
text: dotted line position shown in Fig. 3, so as

name: p3_R_line076
text: to occupy a position entirely within the tank.

name: p3_R_line077
text: Suitable means are provided for securing

name: p3_R_line078
text: the sponson in its normal position exteriorly

name: p3_R_line079
text: of the tank body or frame and while, con-

name: p3_R_line080
text: ceivably, such means may take various

name: p3_R_line081
text: forms, I have disclosed an exemplary means

name: p3_R_line082
text: that may be used, and which I will now de-

name: p3_R_line083
text: scribe.

name: p3_R_line084
text: Carried by the marginal edge of that side

name: p3_R_line085
text: of the sponson which is opposite the pivotal

name: p3_R_line086
text: side thereof is an angle iron or bar 4, one

name: p3_R_line087
text: of the flanges of such bar resting against

name: p3_R_line088
text: the side of the sponson and the other flange

name: p3_R_line089
text: constituting a lip which normally bears

name: p3_R_line090
text: against the inner surface of the side wall 3

name: p3_R_line091
text: of the tank. The angle iron 4 thus also

name: p3_R_line092
text: serves the purpose of limiting the outward

name: p3_R_line093
text: movement of the sponson. Passing through

name: p3_R_line094
text: the said lip and through said wall 3 and pref-

name: p3_R_line095
text: erably through a strengthening member 5,

name: p3_R_line096
text: which may be an angle iron, is a plurality

name: p3_R_line097
text: of securing means, such as screws 6. It will

name: p3_R_line098
text: be noted that, by the provisions of an angle

name: p3_R_line099
text: iron 4, an effective closure is provided be-

name: p3_R_line100
text: tween the side of the sponson and the ad-

name: p3_R_line101
text: jacent edge of the wall 3 of the tank, against

name: p3_R_line102
text: entrance to the tank of dirt, moisture, etc.

name: p3_R_line103
text: The top of the sponson 1, in the normal

name: p3_R_line104
text: position of the latter, is extended so as to

name: p3_R_line105
text: project into the tank as shown in Fig. 2, thus

name: p3_R_line106
text: forming, as it were, a lip 7; and carried on

name: p3_R_line107
text: top of this lip is an angle iron or bar 8, one

name: p3_R_line108
text: of the flanges thereof bearing against the

name: p4_L_line001
text: inner surface of the vertical wall of said

name: p4_L_line002
text: tank, adjacent the opening through which

name: p4_L_line003
text: the sponson projects. Said angle bar 8 may,

name: p4_L_line004
text: obviously, of course, if desired, be secured

name: p4_L_line005
text: to the front wall of the tank, instead of to

name: p4_L_line006
text: the lip 7. This angle bar 8 affords a closure

name: p4_L_line007
text: against entrance to the tank of dirt and

name: p4_L_line008
text: moisture.

name: p4_L_line009
text: Adjacent the hinges 2, suitable means are

name: p4_L_line010
text: provided for preventing the entrance to the

name: p4_L_line011
text: tank of dirt and moisture, and in this in-

name: p4_L_line012
text: stance, such means comprises an angle bar 9

name: p4_L_line013
text: carried by the sponson and contacting, in the

name: p4_L_line014
text: normal position of the sponson, with a sec-

name: p4_L_line015
text: ond angle bar 10 carried by the wall 3 of the

name: p4_L_line016
text: tank.

name: p4_L_line017
text: The sponson 1 may carry a chamber 13 for

name: p4_L_line018
text: the storage of shells. For the sake of light-

name: p4_L_line019
text: ness, the chamber is provided with numer-

name: p4_L_line020
text: ous perforations 14.

name: p4_L_line021
text: While I have, in compliance with the Re-

name: p4_L_line022
text: vised Statutes of the United States, described

name: p4_L_line023
text: with great particularity one form of embodi-

name: p4_L_line024
text: ment of my invention, it is to be understood

name: p4_L_line025
text: that many changes will suggest themselves,

name: p4_L_line026
text: particularly to those skilled in the art to

name: p4_L_line027
text: which the invention pertains, and that all

name: p4_L_line028
text: such changes as come within the scope of the

name: p4_L_line029
text: appended claims constitute no departure

name: p4_L_line030
text: from the spirit of the invention.

name: p4_L_line031
text: Having thus fully described my invention,

name: p4_L_line032
text: what I claim as new and desire to secure by

name: p4_L_line033
text: Letters Patent is:

name: p4_L_line034
text: 1. In a military tank, a sponson normally

name: p4_L_line035
text: disposed exteriorly of the tank and movable

name: p4_L_line036
text: through a wall of the tank to a position with-

name: p4_L_line037
text: in the tank, the sponson closing the wall

name: p4_L_line038
text: when in normal position.

name: p4_L_line039
text: 2. In a military tank, a pivotally mounted

name: p4_L_line040
text: sponson normally disposed exteriorly of the

name: p4_L_line041
text: tank and movable through an opening in the

name: p4_L_line042
text: tank to a position therewithin, the sponson

name: p4_L_line043
text: forming a closure for the opening when in

name: p4_L_line044
text: normal position.

name: p4_L_line045
text: 3. In a military tank, a sponson normally

name: p4_L_line046
text: operating through and forming a closure for

name: p4_L_line047
text: an opening in a wall of the tank, normally

name: p4_L_line048
text: disposed exteriorly thereof and movable to a

name: p4_R_line049
text: position therewithin, and means for prevent-

name: p4_R_line050
text: ing movement of said sponson when posi-

name: p4_R_line051
text: tioned exteriorly of the tank.

name: p4_R_line052
text: 4. In a military tank, a sponson operating

name: p4_R_line053
text: through and forming a closure for an open-

name: p4_R_line054
text: ing therein normally projecting therefrom

name: p4_R_line055
text: and movable to a position therewithin, and

name: p4_R_line056
text: means for securing said sponson in its nor-

name: p4_R_line057
text: mal position, including a member carried by

name: p4_R_line058
text: said sponson and limiting outward move-

name: p4_R_line059
text: ment thereof.

name: p4_R_line060
text: 5. In a military tank, a sponson operating

name: p4_R_line061
text: through and forming a closure for an open-

name: p4_R_line062
text: ing in the tank, said sponson normally pro-

name: p4_R_line063
text: jecting therefrom and movable to a position

name: p4_R_line064
text: therewithin, and means for securing said

name: p4_R_line065
text: sponson in its normal position, including an

name: p4_R_line066
text: angle iron carried by said sponson and limit-

name: p4_R_line067
text: ing outward movement thereof.

name: p4_R_line068
text: 6. In a military tank, a sponson movably

name: p4_R_line069
text: operating through and forming a closure for

name: p4_R_line070
text: an opening in the tank, said sponson nor-

name: p4_R_line071
text: mally projecting therefrom and movable to

name: p4_R_line072
text: a position therewithin, means for securing

name: p4_R_line073
text: said sponson in its normal position, includ-

name: p4_R_line074
text: ing an angle iron carried by said sponson and

name: p4_R_line075
text: limiting outward movement thereof, and se-

name: p4_R_line076
text: curing means passing through said angle

name: p4_R_line077
text: iron and the wall of said tank.

name: p4_R_line078
text: 7. A disappearing sponson for tanks piv-

name: p4_R_line079
text: oted at its forward end and operating

name: p4_R_line080
text: through an opening in a wall of the tank,

name: p4_R_line081
text: and having a protecting shield forming a

name: p4_R_line082
text: complete closure to the opening when the

name: p4_R_line083
text: sponson is in normal position.

name: p4_R_line084
text: 8. A disappearing sponson for tanks or the

name: p4_R_line085
text: like adapted to operate through an opening

name: p4_R_line086
text: in the side of said tank and supporting a

name: p4_R_line087
text: piece of ordnance and forming a closure to

name: p4_R_line088
text: the tank when in its outermost position.

name: p4_R_line089
text: 9. A disappearing combination sponson

name: p4_R_line090
text: and gun mount adapted to operate through

name: p4_R_line091
text: an opening in an armored wall, pivoted at

name: p4_R_line092
text: its forward edge and forming a closure in

name: p4_R_line093
text: the wall when swung to its outermost po-

name: p4_R_line094
text: sition.
